tasks.title: Announcement #69
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
tasks.transcript: Attention, everyone. Due to the forecasted severe weather, the university has decided to cancel all classes and activities tomorrow. Please stay safe and check your email for further updates.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the announcement?

options.A: To explain the severe weather forecast
options.B: To inform students about class cancellations
options.D: To remind students to stay safe

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：这则公告的主要目的是什么？ 定位原文：Due to the forecasted severe weather, the university has decided to cancel all classes and activities tomorrow. 选项分析： A. To explain the severe weather forecast 解释恶劣天气预报。公告只提及预报是取消的原因，并未详细解释天气情况，所以A选项错误。 B. To inform students about class cancellations 通知学生停课。公告的核心内容是告知所有课程和活动取消，所以B选项正确。 C. To discuss next week's schedule 讨论下周的时间安排。公告中未提及下周安排，所以C选项错误。 D. To remind students to stay safe 提醒学生注意安全。公告中提到“注意安全”，但这是附带提醒，并非主要目的，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What are students advised to do in response to the announcement?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：建议学生根据公告做什么？ 定位原文：Please stay safe and check your email for further updates. 选项分析： A. Contact their professors 联系他们的教授。公告中未提及联系教授，所以A选项错误。 B. Prepare for severe weather 为恶劣天气做准备。公告中只提到“注意安全”，并未具体说明如何为恶劣天气做准备，所以B选项不够准确。 C. Check their email for updates 查收邮件以获取最新信息。公告明确说“check your email for further updates”，所以C选项正确。 D. Attend online classes 参加网课。公告宣布所有课程取消，未提及网课，所以D选项错误。
